title: A piecewise tempo map
teaches: A (tempo ...) form opens a new transport segment. Beat and bar positions stay exact, but an s-unit position resolves through the map; the loop length is wall-clock, and a wrap re-enters the early segment at its own tempo.
observe: 120 bpm doubles to 240 at beat 4 (2 s).
2.5 s is beat 6 through the map, not beat 5 under constant tempo.
The emitted bpm lane steps exactly at the boundary.
3.5 s wrapped by the 3 s loop lands in the 120 bpm segment.
